strings.status.info: This Mac is a LemonGalaxy worker: several accounts can sign in at once, and each sees and controls it from its own device list. All of these settings can only be changed on this Mac — never by the server or a controller.
strings.status.startFailed: The remote service failed to start: {0}
strings.status.permMissing: Screen Recording or Accessibility isn't granted yet, so others can't see the screen or use the mouse and keyboard.
strings.status.needsRelogin: An account was reset by the administrator and must sign in again.
strings.status.remoteDisabled: Remote access is disabled: no account can connect and assistance is unavailable.
strings.status.welcome.title: Sign in to accept remote control
strings.status.welcome.body: You can sign in several accounts on the same server. This Mac appears in each account's device list.
strings.events.info: Every connection, file operation and command is logged on this Mac. AI actions are marked; refused connections and blocked AI actions are warnings.
strings.accounts.info: Each account has its own permissions on this Mac. Limits are enforced here even if a controller asks for more. All accounts must be on the same server.
strings.accounts.server.info: All signed-in accounts are on this server. Sign out every account to switch servers.
strings.accounts.needsRelogin: Reset by the administrator — sign in again
strings.accounts.signOut.title: Sign out {0}?
strings.accounts.signOut.body: This account's sessions end immediately and this Mac is removed from its device list. It has to sign in again to control this Mac.
strings.perm.aiCap.info: The most this account's AI may do on this Mac. A controller can't go above it; Off blocks AI entirely.
strings.perm.notify.info: Shows a banner with a disconnect button at the top right when this account connects or its AI acts. The menu bar icon always changes.
strings.perm.systemUser.info: The macOS worker runs as the signed-in macOS user: terminal, files and commands only have that user's permissions.
strings.login.title: Sign in
strings.login.server.info: Copy the full address from the admin console's Server page: host:port#sha256-fingerprint. The fingerprint is pinned, so a replaced certificate is refused.
strings.login.server.locked: Accounts are already signed in on this server, and all accounts must share one server. Sign them all out to switch.
strings.login.systemUser: Remote control runs as macOS user {0}
strings.login.totp.title: Two-factor authentication
strings.login.totp.prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from {0}'s authenticator app.
strings.login.change.title: Set a new password
strings.login.change.prompt: Set your own password for the first sign-in.
strings.login.change.info: The new password never leaves this Mac (OPAQUE), so neither the server nor the administrator learns it. If you forget it, the administrator can reset it and every device must sign in again.
strings.login.change.tooShort: The new password needs at least 8 characters
strings.assist.info: Tell your helper both codes. They enter them in their LemonGalaxy app, and the session starts only after you click Allow. The verification code is generated here and never passes through the server.
strings.assist.needServer: Assistance is paired through a server. Sign in an account first.
strings.assist.needServer.info: After one sign-in, this Mac keeps using that server for assistance even when every account is signed out.
strings.assist.custom.info: 8–16 letters or digits. Can't be changed during a session.
strings.assist.remoteDisabled: Remote access is disabled. Allow it again at the bottom left first.
strings.assist.request.title: Someone wants to control this Mac
strings.assist.request.info: Once allowed, they can see the screen, use the mouse and keyboard, terminal and files. Disconnect any time from the menu bar or the banner. Requests expire after 2 minutes.
strings.perm.info: Remote control needs two system permissions that only you can grant: click Open System Settings and turn on LemonGalaxyWorker (if it isn't listed, click + and choose it from Applications). This page updates automatically; Screen Recording may need the app to be reopened.
strings.perm.screen.purpose: Lets others see this Mac's screen; also used for AI screenshots. Without it only terminal and files work.
strings.perm.accessibility.purpose: Lets others use the mouse and keyboard; also lets AI read on-screen controls. Without it others can only watch.
strings.general.loginItem.info: Starts in the menu bar after you log in to macOS. If you move the app, turn this off and on again.
strings.general.loginItem.unavailable: Only the installed app (in Applications) can open at login.
strings.general.systemNotifications.info: Posts a notification when someone connects or asks for assistance. macOS asks for permission the first time.
strings.general.assistSound: Play a sound for assistance requests
strings.general.menuIconHint: The menu bar icon shows a red dot while someone is connected, an orange dot for AI activity or pending requests, and a slash when remote access is disabled.
strings.general.language.info: Applies immediately. A new language only needs a file in the app's Locales resource folder.
strings.about.update.title: Get new versions from GitHub Releases
strings.about.update.body: New versions are published on GitHub Releases. Install LemonGalaxyWorker-<version>-macOS.dmg over this one; accounts and permissions are kept.
strings.notify.connected.title: Someone connected to this Mac
strings.notify.connected.body: {0} connected from device {1}. Disconnect from the menu bar icon.
